newsitem.title: USA: Capitol Multimedia names new CFO.
newsitem.headline: Capitol Multimedia names new CFO.

text.p: Capitol Multimedia Inc said Tuesday it has named Ed Terino, a vice president of Houghton Mifflin Co, as its new chief financial officer.
Terino, the corporate vice president and director of finance at Houghton Mifflin's school division, will join Capitol Multimedia in December, the company said.
Terino succeeds Catherine Hoopes, whose departure was announced in September when Capitol Multimedia said it was consolidating its operations in Bethesda, Md., and Massachusetts.
Capitol Multimedia, which makes children's CD-ROMs, said in September it was expecting signficant nonrecurring costs in connection with its consolidation.
